name: Kinetic Energy Monitor
description: Writes the translational plus rotational kinetic energy into the custom property 'kinetic_energy' every step (add that property, type float, quantity Energy, to the object first).
script: custom.kinetic_energy = 0.5 * self.mass * dot(self.velocity, self.velocity) + 0.5 * dot(self.angular_velocity, self.inertia * self.angular_velocity)
